evidence_plan.requirement: Correlations of ROUGE variants with evaluations

payload.reason: The evidence provides information on the different variants of ROUGE scores and their correlations with evaluations, indicating variability in their effectiveness.

claims.text: ROUGE consists of several variants, including ROUGE-L, ROUGE-W, ROUGE-S, and ROUGE-SU.
Keyword-based reduction variants have high correlation with ROUGE scores, while other variants show large variance in correlation with manual evaluations.
The lowest F-score correlations are observed for ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-L.
ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-3 have the highest correlation with pyramid scores compared to other ROUGE variants.
Many ROUGE variants do not have high correlations with human pyramid scores, indicating reliability issues.
